title: asplenium striatum var. expansum
intro:
Asplenium striatum var. expansum, commonly known as the Madagascar Leathery Fern, is a type of fern native to Madagascar. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may aid in wound healing and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to soothe skin irritations and promote tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of Asplenium striatum var. expansum have been found to contain flavonoids and phenolic acids, contributing to its medicinal properties.

Note: While the plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, further research is needed to confirm its effectiveness and safety for human use.
